name: reel-studio
description: A local editor for product demonstrations that viewers can pause, scrub and try themselves.

scripts.build:site: pnpm build:viewer && vite build --config vite.site.config.ts && tsx scripts/export.ts projects/receipt-split-release.reel.json --out dist/site/demo && tsx scripts/export.ts projects/retry-queue.reel.json --out dist/site/demo-retries
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && biome check src site tests scripts bench && tsx scripts/check-copy.ts
scripts.demo: pnpm build:viewer && tsx scripts/export.ts projects/receipt-split-release.reel.json --out exports/demo/projects/reel && tsx scripts/static-server.ts exports/demo 4173
scripts.bench: pnpm build && tsx bench/run-correctness.ts --label local && tsx bench/run-browser.ts --label local --protocol 3 && tsx bench/run-export.ts --label local && tsx bench/summarize.ts runs/$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)-local
